referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the material and energy input to mine 1 m3 of hard sandstone. Mining takes place in Switzerland, Zurich. Additives use (lubrication oil etc) and its transport to the mining site are considered. Steel and concrete are used to stabilize the mining site.
referenceFunction.name: Hard sandstone, at mine
